equation-anatomy.alt: The equation x = x-zero plus v t, with callouts: x is the position at time t in meters; x-zero, with subscript 0, is the starting position at t = 0; v is the velocity in meters per second; t is the time since the start in seconds. Below, a two-column rearrangement solves for t: x = x0 + vt; subtract x0 from both sides to get x − x0 = vt; divide both sides by v to get (x − x0)/v = t; write x − x0 as delta x, so t = delta x over v.
